paths.title: Advent Hope
paths.blurb: Walk from Isaiah's promises through the Annunciation and Nativity to the Word made flesh.

paths.title: Covenant
paths.blurb: Trace God's covenant promises from Noah through Abraham, Sinai and David to the new covenant sealed at the Last Supper.

paths.title: From Exodus to Eucharist
paths.blurb: Follow the Passover lamb and the manna in the wilderness to the bread Jesus gives at the Last Supper and in John 6.

paths.title: Lenten Journey
paths.blurb: Follow Lent from the call to return, through temptation, thirst, sight and death, to the gates of Jerusalem.

paths.title: Mary in Scripture
paths.blurb: Follow Mary from the promise of Genesis 3:15 through the Gospels to the woman of Revelation 12.

paths.title: Mercy and Forgiveness
paths.blurb: Walk from David's prayer of repentance through the prophets and parables to the Cross, where mercy is shown at its fullest.

paths.title: Our Father: The Lord's Prayer
paths.blurb: Pray through the Lord's Prayer one petition at a time, with the Scripture that stands behind each line.

paths.title: Praying the Psalms
paths.blurb: Learn many ways of praying through eight psalms: delight, wonder, trust, repentance, longing, refuge, lament and searching.

paths.title: The Risen Lord
paths.blurb: Meet the risen Christ at the tomb, on the road, in the upper room and on the shore.

paths.title: The Suffering Servant
paths.blurb: Read Isaiah's servant songs as the Church has, and follow them to the Passion and the hymn of Philippians 2.

paths.title: Temple and Presence
paths.blurb: Follow God's dwelling among his people from the tabernacle and Solomon's Temple to Christ's body, the Church, and the new Jerusalem.

paths.title: The Good Shepherd
paths.blurb: Follow the shepherd image from the prophets and the Psalms to the Gospels, where Christ names himself the Good Shepherd and commissions Peter to feed his sheep.

paths.title: The Name of God
paths.blurb: Follow the divine Name from the burning bush to Jesus' own "I AM" in the Gospel of John.

paths.title: From Water to Baptism
paths.blurb: Trace the waters of Scripture from creation and the flood to the Jordan, and see why the Church reads them as signs of baptism.

paths.title: Wisdom and the Word
paths.blurb: Trace Wisdom from the Old Testament's poetry to the Word made flesh in John and Colossians.
